Designed in Creo. Tested to thermal runaway.

I’m Jayraj Dane, a mechanical design engineer with 3.5 years in PTC Creo, Windchill and SolidWorks. For my M.Sc. thesis I designed a seven-cell test module and ran twelve thermal-runaway tests on it. This page is my unsolicited application to Kreisel Electric.

    From one converted car to John Deere

    In 2013 the Kreisel brothers converted their first car to electric. A year later they founded Kreisel Electric, headquartered in Rainbach im Mühlkreis since 2017. In December 2021 John Deere agreed to take majority ownership.

      Why every cell sits in fluid

      Many packs cool each cell through one face. Kreisel’s patented immersion cooling wets the whole can. My 2D model of one 21700 cell shows what that does to the hot spot.

      Heat per cell2.0 W

      Temperature rise above the coolant
      0 K
      My assumptions

      Steady state, 5 Ah cell, heat Q = I²R spread evenly. A flat 21 × 70 mm slice with 1.6 W/m·K across the cell (a cylinder-equivalent value) and 25 W/m·K along it. Coolant touches the bottom face, a 47 mm side strip, or every face. A real design needs 3D CFD and tests. Edit the film coefficients, in W/m²·K:

      Safety built into every pack

      From Kreisel’s technology pages.

      • PropagationKept to a minimum and tested in-house against criteria stricter than the norms.
      • Controlled degassingGas leaves in a controlled way and a defective cell is shut down.
      • Fused cellsEvery cell has its own fuse, so a faulty one is isolated.
      • Under 1 °C spreadAcross a module, measured in the lab.
      • IP67, burst-proofHousing tested in any installation position.
      • −40 to +60 °COperating range of the off-highway systems.

      CHIMERO: 180 kW from a small grid connection

      A battery inside the charger covers the peaks, so the grid only has to supply the average. My M.Sc. covered distribution grids and EV charging, so I modelled an afternoon at one unit.

      From the grid to carsFrom the buffer to carsGrid connection

      My simplified model: power shared across both cables, battery support up to 120 kW, cars taper above 55 % and leave at 80 %, losses ignored. Move the grid slider to see when the buffer runs dry.

      A real site. ORLEN Austria’s station in Ried delivers up to 180 kW from about 90 kW of grid capacity, about three months from first contact to commissioning.

      My thesis: four ways to stop heat spreading

      Twelve nail-penetration tests on a seven-cell module I designed in Creo, with 71 neighbour readings. M.Sc. at FH Oberösterreich with TZE Ruhstorf, July 2026.

      Honest limits

      • Neighbours were uncharged dummies: heat delivered, not a cascade.
      • Three trials per setup, nail penetration only.
      • Passive barriers in air, not an immersion-cooled module.

      What carries over to Kreisel

      • Designing fixtures and test articles for abuse tests.
      • Multichannel data, handled honestly when a channel fails.
      • Thinking in heat paths: spacing, barriers, conduction.
